linkedin_activity.text: Une page se tourne... Après plus de quarante années d'engagement au sein du Groupe Pharma Santé, l'heure est venue de profiter d'une retraite bien méritée. Lorsque j'ai rejoint cette formidable entreprise, je n'imaginais pas que l'ensemble de ma carrière professionnelle s'y déroulerait. J'ai eu la chance d'y exercer différentes fonctions, tout d'abord comme pharmacien gérant, puis comme responsable des achats, de l'activité grossiste et de la qualité. Ces nombreuses années m'ont permis d'accompagner les évolutions du secteur pharmaceutique tout en restant fidèle aux valeurs qui ont toujours animé notre groupe. Cette année revêt d'ailleurs une dimension particulière puisque Pharma Santé célèbre ses 125 ans d'existence. Une longévité remarquable qui témoigne de la solidité de son projet, de sa capacité d'adaptation et de son engagement constant au service de la santé. Au-delà des fonctions et des responsabilités exercées, je retiendrai avant tout les valeurs qui ont guidé notre action au quotidien : la solidarité, l'engagement social, la défense des patients, l'accès à des soins de qualité et l'importance du juste conseil pharmaceutique. Ce sont elles qui ont donné tout son sens à mon parcours professionnel. Je tiens également à remercier chaleureusement l'ensemble de mes collègues, ainsi que les différentes directions qui se sont succédés au fil des années. J'ai eu le privilège d'évoluer dans une structure à la fois professionnelle, familiale et à taille humaine, où les relations humaines ont toujours occupé une place essentielle. Aujourd'hui, je quitte la vie active avec de nombreux souvenirs, une profonde gratitude et une grande fierté pour le chemin parcouru ensemble. Je forme le vœu que Pharma Santé poursuive encore longtemps sa mission en proposant aux patients des médicaments et des soins pharmaceutiques de qualité, associés au meilleur conseil et aux meilleurs prix, dans le respect des valeurs qui ont fait sa réputation depuis 125 ans. Merci à toutes celles et tous ceux qui ont croisé ma route et contribué à cette belle aventure professionnelle. Au plaisir de rester en contact et de suivre les futurs succès de Pharma Santé.
linkedin_activity.text_en: A page is turning... After more than forty years of commitment within the Pharma Santé Group, the time has come to enjoy a well-deserved retirement. When I joined this great company, I never imagined that my entire professional career would take place there. I had the chance to perform various functions, first as managing pharmacist, then as head of purchasing, wholesale activity and quality. These many years have allowed me to support developments in the pharmaceutical sector while remaining faithful to the values that have always animated our group. This year also has a special dimension since Pharma Santé is celebrating its 125th anniversary. A remarkable longevity that testifies to the solidity of its project, its adaptability and its constant commitment to the service of health. Beyond the functions and responsibilities performed, I will above all retain the values that have guided our daily action: solidarity, social commitment, patient advocacy, access to quality care and the importance of fair pharmaceutical advice. They are the ones who gave my career path its full meaning. I would also like to warmly thank all my colleagues, as well as the various departments that have succeeded each other over the years. I have had the privilege of working in a professional, family and human-sized structure, where human relations have always played an essential role. Today, I leave the active life with many memories, deep gratitude and great pride for the journey we have made together. I hope that Pharma Santé will continue its mission for a long time to come by offering patients quality medicines and pharmaceutical care, combined with the best advice and the best prices, in accordance with the values that have made its reputation for 125 years. Thank you to all those who crossed my path and contributed to this great professional adventure. Looking forward to staying in touch and following Pharma Santé's future successes.

We have become incredibly sophisticated at describing HCPs. Segments, behaviors, channel preferences, prescribing patterns, personas. But describing someone is not the same as understanding them. This recent IQVIA piece on the “persona gap” makes a very good point: Physicians can look almost identical in the data and still react completely differently to the same engagement. This is where I think customer engagement still has a blind spot. The real advantage is not having more segmentation variables. It is understanding the context behind the behavior well enough to know why someone reacts the way they do and capturing what HCPs actually tell us, not just what they do. https://lnkd.in/dkhjtDcT

Germany's health ministry has put forward a regulation that would oblige recognition authorities to accept English-language documents from foreign-trained doctors, dentists, pharmacists and midwives, and to run the procedure digitally. The regulation supplements the recognition-acceleration law already passed, and it standardises a process that currently differs across the 16 Länder. A second provision lets people who began medical or pharmacy training abroad complete it in Germany in exceptional cases, which is aimed in part at Ukrainian professionals. The Bundesrat votes on 16 October, with a November start planned. Health Minister Carsten Linnemann framed it as a bureaucracy problem: anyone who wants to win skilled staff for the health system cannot slow them down with paperwork. For hospital HR and recruitment teams, the practical shift sits in the document pack. Credential files assembled in English for Gulf, UK, Irish or Indian employers become usable in Germany without a certified-translation stage, which is where recognition timelines quietly lose weeks. Reported by Der Spiegel and dts Nachrichtenagentur, with physician figures from the Bundesärztekammer. At the end of 2025, 71,480 doctors working in Germany held no German passport, 16 percent of the profession and roughly double the 2015 share. The projected shortfall is about 50,000 doctors by 2040. #MSinGermany #LaborMarket #Fachkräftemangel
